title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby C) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/24
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) -> Cassette (JVC KD-V6/XLII-S90/Dolby C)

ai_review.summary: A crystal‑clear 24‑bit soundboard captures an Oct 10 1982 Frost show that’s on fire – Brent’s organ, Jerry’s guitar and a string of standout jams.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑110783 restoration delivers a very clean SBD with just a hint of hiss and early‑song balance quirks that disappear quickly. Musically the concert is a high‑energy classic: Brent’s opening organ solo, a smoking Sugaree, tight Crazy Fingers, an early Touch of Grey, and a double‑encore that closes on powerful Black Peter and Satisfaction.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5‑star), highlighting both superb performance and high‑quality soundboard restoration; only minor technical blemishes are noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit SBD praised as one of the best from the Brent era – crisp, slightly gritty in a pleasing way, with early balance hiccups and a faint hiss that are quickly resolved.

standout_songs: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds solidly with strong organ and guitar work; second set ramps up into a tight jam sequence, double‑encore keeps the momentum high and ends on an uplifting note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "on fire", top of his game with a nice gain boost and superb soloing throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Prominent, present, and driving the low‑freq pulse; noted for making the "Northbound Train" and carpet‑bombing the drum break on SSDD.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal flourishes praised (extra verse on Rooster, spoken‑word bits), though occasional “cheese” remarks were made.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s organ/piano work highlighted as a major highlight – fire on Minglewood, strong jams on Far From Me and Playing in the Band.
band_member_comments.Drums: Both drummers described as "on fire" especially during the double encore; Lesh’s bass‑drum interplay noted.
